name: fr.amacunia/clia-laboratory-certificate-expiration-renewal
title: CLIA Certificate Renewal Sentinel
description: When does a US clinical laboratory's CLIA certificate expire, and is its renewal window open?

tools.name: clia_certificate_example
tools.description: Free sample: a real answer, same shape as clia_certificate_lookup.

tools.name: clia_certificate_lookup
tools.description: Use this when you need to know whether a US clinical laboratory's CLIA certificate is close to expiring: for 1 to 10 CLIA numbers, the certificate type, the expiration date on file with CMS, the 9-to-12-month renewal window of 42 CFR part 493, the billing calendar CMS describes today, days left, and whether the quarterly file still covers that date. No laboratory names, no addresses. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

numbers.description: 1 to 10 CLIA numbers (two ASCII digits, the letter D, seven ASCII digits), comma-separated

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.
